newsitem.title: USA: Nalco Chemical sees further growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Nalco Chemical sees further growth in 1997.

text.p: Nalco Chemical Co on Thursday said sales increased and gross margin improved in the first quarter and the company expected further growth in 19997.
"We are well positioned for growth and fully expect that 1997 will be a very good year for Nalco," Chairman and Chief Executive Ted Mooney said in a statement.

Nalco, which provides water treatment and process chemicals, services and systems, said first-quarter earnings rose to $0.49 a share on a primary basis from $0.43 in the year-earlier quarter. Revenues advanced to $334.6 million from $301.9 million.
